flags.observation: "the new state religion is The Narrative" turns the card's demand for faith into an equation; meaning shifts.
"thank the elite for serfdom" changes whom the card says you thank; card thanks the puppet, not the elite.
WHO Treaty beat sung flat with no opener; health-body claim lands as plain fact, satire signal absent in this beat.
Opener "Older than Mockingbird" ranks The Black Nobility as a real, older puppeteer; frame extends the claim.
"Wear the joke too" bridges streetwear to a shield, which is carried, not worn; the yes-and logic slips.
